question:
Rearrange the sentences to form a coherent paragraph:
 A. Version control records changes over time 
B. It allows rollback to earlier versions 
C. It is useful for collaborative projects 
D. It prevents conflicts while working together
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins by introducing the concept of version control (Sentence A).
 
• **Sentence A** is the first sentence as it introduces the concept: Versi
